Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MRK.
We generated $19.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 186 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2023.
Operating income reached $2.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 23% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $24.4 billion this quarter, representing 23% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
